title: 多摩モノレール1000形 Tama Monorail 1000 series
description: This pack adds the Tama Monorail for MTR3.
body:
The Tama Monorail is a monorail line in Tokyo that operates between Kamikitadai Station and Tama Center Station.
*Rails are not included. Please use the separate Chongqing Monorail Train Pack for rails:
https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/chongqing-metro-monorail-train-pack

*For MTR3 Only. Since this assumes the use of the aforementioned pack, it is only compatible with MTR3.
